label: Will the world pass 2 degrees Celsius over pre-industrial levels before 2050?
differs: Market counts any single year at or above 2.0°C before 2050. The line needs the 20-year mean to cross in 2049–2051 with emissions past their peak, which is harder.

label: When will nuclear fusion be achieved? — Before 2035
differs: Market rule says only that fusion is 'achieved' before 2035. The line needs a plant that delivers net electricity to a grid over a full year.

label: When will nuclear fusion be achieved? — Before 2030
differs: Market is any fusion 'achieved' before 2030. The line is Helion specifically, with metered delivery to Microsoft in 2028–2030.

label: Will humans colonize Mars before 2050?
differs: Market needs a self-sufficient colony of at least 10 people for a year before 2050. The line needs an outpost occupied continuously for 24 months by the end of 2053.

label: Which country will be the next to send humans to the Moon? — China
differs: Market pays only if China gets there before the US, by 2031. The line counts a Chinese crewed landing in 2030–2031 whoever is first.

label: Will any company announce that it has achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) before Jan 1, 2031?
differs: Market resolves on a company's announcement. The line needs a measured result on a frozen task suite, reproduced, in 2034–2040.

label: Will the U.S. confirm that aliens exist before Jan 20, 2029?
differs: Shown inverted (100% minus the market). Market is a US official statement by 2029; the line is no IAU-recognized detection through 2180.

label: Pandemic by Dec 31, 2029?
differs: Market is a WHO pandemic declaration within three years. The line needs one million confirmed deaths by 2050.

label: New pandemic before 2028?
differs: WHO declaration before 2028; shorter horizon again.

label: When will the first useful quantum computer be developed? — Before 2035
differs: Market: RSA-2048 broken, or FeMoco or P450 simulated accurately, before 2035. The line: an error-corrected chemistry result that beats the best classical method, published 2030–2033.

label: When will the first useful quantum computer be developed? — Before 2030
differs: Same rule with a 2030 deadline. The gap between the two prices is the market's odds for 2030–2034.

label: AI regulation by 2028?
differs: Market needs a federal law restricting LLM products before 2028. The line needs binding duties on frontier developers with enforcement, around 2029.

label: Comprehensive federal AI framework becomes US law before 2028?
differs: Standards plus transparency provisions in one law before 2028. Barely traded.

label: Will independent AI safety audits become U.S. law before Jan 1, 2028?
differs: Market is a federal audit law. The line is a pacing agreement among labs with outside evaluators inside.

label: Will the House pass a bill regulating AI in political ads?
differs: Market is House passage before 2028, one step on the way. The line needs a federal or EU rule in force by the end of 2029.

label: Will the compound annual growth rate in U.S. nonfarm business labor productivity between the annual observations for 2026 and 2031 be above 2.5% per year?
differs: Market is the five-year average for 2026–2031. The line needs three straight years above 2.5%, the last in 2032–2036.

label: Will the US and China announce an AI safety agreement by December 31, 2027?
differs: Market is an announced agreement, of which a compute cap is one qualifying kind. The line is talks whose agenda includes compute verification, around 2030.

label: Will China blockade Taiwan by December 31, 2027?
differs: Market is a blockade of 24 hours or more by 2027. The line is a 90-day cut-off of leading-edge chips at any point through 2032.

label: Will China invade Taiwan by June 30, 2027?
differs: An invasion, not a blockade, and a shorter window.

label: AI bubble burst by June 30, 2027?
differs: Market needs three of six stress events (Nvidia down 50%, SOXX down 40%, a lab bankruptcy and so on) by mid-2027. The line is the SOX closing 50% below its peak in 2027–2030.

label: Tesla Optimus on sale before 2028?
differs: Retail availability by 2028. The line needs autonomous humanoids in 1% of households of one OECD country, around 2036.

label: Will the FDA approve VERVE-102 before Jan 1, 2032?
differs: One candidate drug. The line counts any systemically delivered in-body editor for a disease with over 100,000 US patients, 2029–2031.

label: Will OpenAI or Anthropic announces it has achieved recursive self-improvement before Jan 1, 2029?
differs: Market resolves on an announcement. The line needs AI leading most of a lab's R&D for three months, verified by an embedded evaluator.
